anomalies.title: Repo cache carries no landcover array; landcover scenarios ran on a derived real-landcover site
anomalies.detail: The real 500x500@2m Austin tile's packed cache (Input_subset/processed_inputs/incremental_cache_0_0) has no landcover array, so paint edits would be refused on it. U3/U6/U7 ran on the 'lr' derived site: the real site byte-for-byte plus the REAL Austin landcover (Input_rasters/Landcover.tif) cropped to the tile extent, repacked as a fresh cache with the repo cache's exact solar geometry. All non-landcover arrays verified bitwise-equal to the repo cache (site_verification.json).

anomalies.title: Twin oracles recompute SVF fresh inside run_full_tile; twins do not pre-stage SVF artifacts
anomalies.detail: run_full_tile always stages its own scratch site and recomputes SVF, so physically edited twins need only their edited rasters plus a fresh cache pack. This mirrors the packet's own E2E twin construction and keeps the oracle independent of any executor SVF artifact. Baseline reproducibility (SANITY) confirms the SVF recompute is bitwise-stable run-to-run.

anomalies.title: U7 store index shows only revision 3 after the final FULL publish — R2 supersede semantics, not data loss
anomalies.detail: First U7 adjudication expected window_entries('utci', 12) to carry revisions [1,2,3]. The store's R2 retention rule (u-c1-review) supersedes only entries whose write windows INTERSECT the newer batch's windows: met(FULL) -> paint(local) -> params(FULL) means the final full-tile publish intersects every earlier entry, so the live index legitimately carries revision 3 only. Multi-revision index chains appear when windows are disjoint (see tests/test_incremental_uc8_residual_sweep.py). Revisions 1 and 2 remain durable and readable as patch directories (rev-000001..rev-0000003, load_patch-verified, revision and variables intact). Adjudication corrected to the engine's contract; physics comparisons unaffected.

anomalies.title: Harness path bug: patch directories nest under results/<scenario>/<scenario>/rev-*
anomalies.detail: The U7/U8 first pass globbed results/<scenario>/rev-* (one level too shallow), producing two false FAIL reasons ('store revisions [3]', 'no rev dir after retry'). The retry HAD published exactly one rev dir and U7 had all three. Harness fixed to derive the scenario dir from executed.patch_paths[0].parent; U7 and U8 were rerun from a clean publication state. No engine behavior involved.

anomalies.title: U2/U7 lack a met-only LR twin; met-only physics checked against the repo-site rmet twin plus in-batch checks
anomalies.detail: For U7 batch 1 the LR-site met edit was checked for shadow bitwise-vs-LR-baseline and pre-edit steps bitwise-vs-LR-baseline; the edited step's oracle is the same physical met edit proven bitwise on the repo site in U2. Landcover enters the met solve identically in both chains (real landcover array in LR twins), and the accumulated state is fully covered by the lr_metlc oracle at batch 2 and lr_metlc_params at batch 3.
